label: Происходить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for происходить (to happen, to occur).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Происходит' is the core -ит form of происходить, the most common usage since the verb mainly takes inanimate subjects. 'Что здесь' makes a very frequent question.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Происходят' shows the -ят ending of происходить with a plural subject. 'Странные вещи в доме' sets an eerie scene.
Strategic focus: Present, habitual. 'Происходит' is the -ит form of происходить, here marking a recurring event. 'Каждый день' stresses the regularity.
Strategic focus: Present, instrumental government. 'Происходит' is the 3sg of происходить. 'С тобой' shows the с + instrumental pattern for what is happening to someone.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Происходят' is the -ят form of происходить with the subject 'перемены'. 'Медленно' describes the pace of change.
Strategic focus: Past, neuter. 'Происходило' is the neuter -ло form of происходить, agreeing with the neuter 'что-то'. The imperfective stresses an ongoing past event.

missions.phrase: Авария происходила прямо на наших глазах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Происходила' adds the feminine -ла ending of происходить. 'На наших глазах' is an idiom meaning right before our eyes.
Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Происходили' is the plural -ли past of происходить. 'Часто' marks the repeated nature, fitting the imperfective; the perfective partner is произойти.

missions.phrase: Никто не знает, что будет происходить дальше.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future, infinitive use. 'Будет' is the auxiliary and 'происходить' stays in the infinitive, forming the compound future. 'Что дальше' frames the uncertainty.
Strategic focus: Present in reported speech. 'Происходит' stays in the present -ит form inside the subordinate clause, even after a past main verb. This shows Russian keeps relative tense.
